quotes.context: What are my transfer options with OFX?

quotes.text: When transferring with OFX United Kingdom, there are no transfer fees.

Pay in 30+ currencies with total visibility and automated receipt capture.
Take advantage of a great introductory rate across these 7 currencies on your first personal transfer when booked online.
